details: Each series-period must appear exactly once.
Overall status must use the approved status vocabulary.
Overall severity must be normal, moderate, high, or unavailable.
Overall direction must use the approved direction vocabulary.
Detector coverage must use the approved coverage vocabulary.
Overall dashboard alert must equal historical OR forecast alert.
Confirmed anomaly requires both dashboard alert types.
Historical alert status requires historical alert only.
Forecast alert status requires forecast alert only.
Overall status is unavailable only when neither detector is available.
Normal requires detector coverage and no active dashboard alert.
Detector coverage must match historical and forecast availability.
Every dashboard alert must have moderate or high severity.
Normal observations must have normal overall severity.
Unavailable observations must have unavailable overall severity.
Forecast detector availability requires a matched forecast record.
